name: dtc-scraper
title: DTC Code Scraper - All Car Brands
description: Scrapes diagnostic trouble codes (DTC) from troublecodes.net for all car brands. Produces a file-tree structured JSON database organized by brand, with generic OBD-II codes, manufacturer-specific codes, and detailed code descriptions.

dataset.title: DTC Codes Database
dataset.description: All scraped DTC codes organized by brand
